question: Work only in the provided graph. For each of these 12 species — Cyperus amplissimus, Dendroctonus keeni, Taraxacum adustum, Eupalea conglomerata, Hydroptila veracruzensis, Nannocampus pictus, Grammia blakei, Oberea rotundipennis, Thrips unispinus, Eutropis cumingi, Mycetophila tuberosa, Saturnus harpe — climb the relation that places a taxon inside the next one up and report the NEAREST ancestor that is a taxonomic family. This graph does not record taxonomic rank as a property: a taxon's rank is stated only in its free-text description, and those descriptions exist in whichever of the six languages (en, fr, de, zh, ar, ru) happens to carry one — English is not guaranteed. Report exactly one family per species.

answer.format: Call FINAL with exactly this JSON and no prose: {"families":{"Q<species>":"Q<family>", ...}} with one entry per species.

certificate.rank_is_not_a_property: P105 is banned from the world, so rank is reachable only through description text
certificate.substring_trap: every chain passes an ancestor described as a 'subfamily', which contains the string 'family'
certificate.cross_lingual: descriptions are missing in English on some chain members and must be read in another language

baseline.policy: first ancestor whose English description contains 'family'
